specification.title: Behavioral and experimental economics
specification.outcome: Design and critique evidence about nonstandard preferences and beliefs.

activation: After completion of previously assigned authorship/peer work. Adjacent drafting against canonical prerequisites authorized; acceptance strictly dependency ordered.
scope: Behavioral and experimental economics: nonstandard time/risk/social preferences and beliefs, experimental identification and implementation, replication/external validity, welfare criteria and intervention. Five complete original cases/ten full exercises. Include global/corner choice, credible experimental estimands, observer/demand effects and normative ambiguity. Avoid interpreting every rejection of a standard model as irrationality.
requirements: Read canonical spec and necessary accepted prerequisite content. Keep original prose coherent and precise, all methods needed for exercises taught. Units, global/corner proofs, source scope, teach-back and delayed retention complete. About4000–6000total words if sufficient; no padding or abbreviated survey.

Retrieve only necessary primary source methods, reuse prior verified stable scopes honestly. Source list proposed with id/title/url/use/checked/verification/limits and precise bounded inspection. No decorative media, paid services, packages/frameworks or current claims without verification.

Chapter five or fewer substantive worked articles class=worked, at least8 (prefer10) exact exercises in ol.exercises with IDs; every full solution in details.solutions using matching data-solution-for. Inline data-input/data-result markers for primitive/output checking. Do not invent external validation.

Quiet stdlib author check(root=None), silent CLI, exactly four runtime files, three nonself bindings. Explicit invalid-domain guards survive -O. All numeric displays independently recomputed from declared primitives with boundary/global witnesses; proofs fully read not replaced by test grids.

Execute actual quiet normal API, optimized isolated exact4quietAPI and silentCLI from /; exact file/directory membership/everybyte unchanged. Evidence prefixed /private/tmp. Freeze and report final inventory; separate peer/root acceptance still required.

Own only these four paths and prefixed tmp files. No shared curriculum/sourcecatalogue/STATUS/build/hosting edits, no other manuscript writes or children. Report scope map early then continue without approval.
